iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: IAEA access and safeguards pressure remains severe. Search results show continuing limited access to declared enrichment facilities, renewed UN-watchdog pressure, and Iranian activation of another enrichment site after watchdog censure. No verified top-level enrichment jump identified.

iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR / GULF
iran_conventional.notes: Iran/Gulf conventional risk remains near maximum. Search results show Israel-Iran strike-cycle reporting, warnings of harsher attacks if hostile acts continue, AP reporting that the strait was closed again, and continued energy-route exposure.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: Conditional Israel-Lebanon truce channel exists, but Hezbollah rejection and continuing Israeli strikes keep breach and buildup indicators active. The de-escalatory channel is real but not yet controlling events.

turkey.name: TURKEY REGIONAL
turkey.notes: Turkey remains indirectly exposed through the Iran war, Syria and Iraq, but search results were policy analysis and regional-positioning pieces rather than a fresh Turkish force surge or weapons trial.

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: India-Pakistan remains elevated. CFR and regional reporting cite continuing post-Pahalgam tension and harsh rhetoric, but fresh results did not confirm a new cross-border strike or verified force surge.

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: Russia-NATO risk remains driven by official nuclear signaling and hybrid-pressure analysis. DGAP and NATO materials confirm persistent rhetoric toward Ukraine and the West, but no direct NATO clash trigger surfaced.

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: China-Taiwan results remain dominated by older drill/background and social-video material. No fresh blockade, live-fire surge, or direct clash crossed threshold in this scan.

north_korea.name: NORTH KOREA
north_korea.notes: DPRK results include social/video claims and April weapons coverage, but no fresh verified launch event or atomic-device event in this window. Risk eases slightly while remaining critical on baseline capability and posture.

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
russia_ukraine.notes: Russia-Ukraine remains at maximum. Search results show continuing deep-strike dynamics, warnings of systematic attacks on Kyiv, UN concern over Romania/NATO spillover, and persistent Russian strategic rhetoric.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Pakistan-Afghanistan remains critical. Janes/OCHA background and fresh border-clash reporting indicate the February-April escalation baseline has not normalized; fresh high-grade sourcing is thinner but the border-war risk persists.

sudan.name: SUDAN CIVIL WAR
sudan.notes: Sudan/RSF search results were mostly stale or non-conflict travel-health items in this window; baseline civil-war spillover remains critical but no fresh 24-hour strike trigger crossed threshold.

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE
israel_palestine.notes: Reuters and Al Jazeera report Israeli strikes killing civilians in Gaza while Egypt hosts renewed truce talks; active talks are not preventing lethal strikes.

south_sudan_abyei.name: SOUTH SUDAN / ABYEI
south_sudan_abyei.notes: No fresh Abyei/South Sudan escalation surfaced; localized violence risk remains elevated by baseline fragility and Sudan spillover.
